title: The Department of Sociology and Political and Legal Disciplines took part in a scientific conference.

blocks.text: On May 14, 2025, students and teachers of the Department of Sociology and Political and Legal Disciplines of the Social and Psychological Faculty of BSU named after K. Karasaev took part in the inter-university scientific and practical student conference on the topic: "The Role of Youth in Promoting Human Rights". The conference was held at the Kyrgyz State University named after I. Arabaev and the Institute of History and Socio-Political Research named after E. Zh. Maanaev.
